author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 1.9.6 - release-readiness hardening ahead of v2.0.0, prompted by an external review of the 1.9.5 build, then a second pass on this build that caught two things the first fix missed. A failed device enumeration at the very start of a scan now aborts cleanly instead of continuing against an empty device list, and the unreadable-device count is now reset before that enumeration runs rather than after, so a failed attempt can no longer report a stale count left over from an earlier scan. Export JSON's scan status now distinguishes a genuinely complete scan from one that finished with gaps. Device and app names (free text the hub owner controls) are now HTML-escaped everywhere they render into a panel - Pivot tables, Insights, the inert-app panel, and the Back-to link - closing a gap those four had that External systems and Device icons already closed. The JSON blob embedded in the page now encodes every '<' character rather than pattern-matching closing-tag spellings, closing a bypass a device name with unusual spacing or capitalisation in a closing tag could otherwise exploit. Export JSON now says so explicitly if it could not reach the hub for external system or device icon data when generated, instead of silently exporting null as though nothing were declared. Exit map now falls back to the hub's local/LAN address when the page was opened through Hubitat's cloud endpoint - works for anyone with LAN access to the hub, though not for a genuinely remote user with no other route to it. vis-network and mermaid are now pinned to exact versions instead of latest/a major-only tag, so a library update elsewhere can no longer change this app's behaviour with no corresponding release here. And closing one floating panel while another is still open behind it no longer pops the legend back into view on top of it.
